sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Sew it Good - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hey, brother! I really need a big backpack, the purple one called the Pilgrim. I also need one of those fleece ski mask hats.\n\nBut it's not that simple. No middlemen, everything has to be found yourself. Take it off a body if you want, I don't care. Can't tell you why, sorry."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find 1 Ski hat with holes for eyes in raid
- Hand over 1 Ski hat with holes for eyes to Ragman
- Find 1 Pilgrim tourist backpack in raid
- Hand over 1 Pilgrim tourist backpack to Ragman

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Hazard 4 Takedown sling backpack (MultiCam)
- Unlocks purchase of Hazard 4 Takedown sling backpack (MultiCam) at Ragman LL2
- Unlocks purchase of 6B13 assault armor (Flora) at Ragman LL2
"You took it off a Scav, didn't you? Whatever, doesn't matter to me. The result is what counts."
